method.chinese: Complete supplied manuscripts, with bounded corrections recorded as exact old/new edits in each article JSON. All 370 body paragraphs retained. Original receipts are preserved separately.
method.traditional: Full local character conversion with context-sensitive editorial corrections; not an abridgment.
method.english: Independently written by the primary agent against the Chinese section structure, retaining the arguments, examples and conclusions. Paragraph boundaries may differ. No translation service or delegated drafting used.
method.external_manuscripts: Read-only; SHA-256 values checked against received receipts before publication.
method.statistics_caveat: Paragraph and word totals demonstrate inventory, not literary quality or proof of semantic equivalence.

source_checks.subject: Descartes editions, replies and translation differences
decisions: Do not make parer à mean exclusively a head-on answer; preserve the qualified contrast with Latin declinavi.
Remove unverified exact page-length ratios and counts of insulting forms of address, retaining their argumentative role.
Distinguish the visible fly/music textual difference from the hostile Revius report about its provenance; do not infer an established motive.
Retain the distinction between requested omission, subsequent permission and later editors' choices.

source_checks.subject: Spinoza Latin structure and numerical claims
decisions: Retain only approximate word-length comparisons for scholia and demonstrations; totals vary with section boundaries and tokenization.
Do not publish precise first-person verb counts without a morphological audit. Preserve the singular/plural narrative contrast in qualitative terms.
Remove an unverified exhaustive partition of the appendix and exact temporal-reference grouping.
Keep physical and everyday examples as explanatory analogies, not independent proofs of Spinoza's metaphysical claims.
